definitions.gloss: under (someone's guidance, rule or protection; given conditions)
definitions.explanation: In ~の{下|もと}で or ~の{下|もと}に: under the influence, authority, care or conditions of something. A formal, written use; in the physical sense "below", the character is read した.

examples.english: All people are equal under the law.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{指導|しどう}→指導：03190_shidou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下|もと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}める→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: To carry out research under the professor's guidance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{送|おく}り{迎|むか}え→送り迎え：14362_okurimukae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下|もと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦アルバイト→アルバイト：01528_arubaito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{許|ゆる}した→許す：02325_yurusu⟧。
examples.english: We allowed our daughter's evening part-time job on condition that we drop her off and pick her up.

notes:
WATCH OUT:
The character ⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧ usually means below, under (read した). In this abstract sense after ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ it is read もと: ⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下|もと}, ⟦{指導|しどう}→指導：03190_shidou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下|もと}. The same もと is often written in kana (~⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧) or as ⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧/{許|もと} (⟦{親元|おやもと}→親元：20220_oyamoto⟧, ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{許|もと}).

- ~⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下|もと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: under (guidance, care, rule) — ⟦{両親|りょうしん}→両親：00806_ryoushin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下|もと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{育|そだ}つ→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧
- ~⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下|もと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: on condition that ~
